profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Samsung SmartThings
profile.summary:
- 2+ years of experience with cross client teams (Android, iOS and Web) and end-to-end system design between Client and Cloud
- 7+ years of experience with technical and team lead in Android projects
- 4+ years of experience with Kotlin programming and 9 years of experience with Java programming and debugging skills and in developing native Android application and framework with deep knowledge of best practices, MVVM/MVP, APIs and libraries (RxJava, Dagger, Retrofit, OkHttp, etc) and with Git, Gerrit, Github, Gitlab, Pull Request and Rebasing
- 1+ years of experience with HTML/CSS/JavaScript programming and in developing Tizen Wearable application with strong understanding of application architecture and object-oriented design
- 5 months of experience with C programming and in developing Tizen Wearable service app
- 6 months of experience with Objective-C programming and in developing iOS application
- 7+ years experience with C++ programming and debugging skills and in designing and implementing S60 applications and components on Symbian with strong Object Oriented programming
- 4 years experience with C programming and debugging skills and in developing CDMA data service protocols in Qualcomm REX
- Proficient oral and written communication skills with the result of excellent troubleshooting 
- Highly motivated, well-organized, fast self-learner and team player

Specialties: Smart Home, Connected Car, TV, Multimedia, Telecommunications, Android, Tizen, Html/CSS/JavaScript, iOS, Qt/QML, Symbian OS, S60 Platform, GSM/WCDMA, CDMA
